name: Colgate-Palmolive
description: Colgate-Palmolive sells toothpaste, toothbrushes, soap, shower gel, dish and laundry products and, through Hill's, prescription and everyday pet food. Oral care is 44% of net sales, pet nutrition 23%, personal care 17%, home care 16% (FY2025). It sells through retailers and wholesalers in about 200 countries and territories (Walmart is about 11% of sales), and Hill's pet food is sold through vets, pet-supply stores and online. Money comes from small, frequently repurchased products at prices set by brand strength: Colgate holds 41.3% of the global toothpaste market. FY2025 operating profit fell 23% to $3,306M mainly because of a $919M non-cash write-down of the skin health business (Filorga) after weak China demand; excluding one-offs the business still grew.

gics.note: Conventional filing: sector and sub-industry from Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); industry group and industry not on that page, so null. EDGAR SIC 2844 (Perfumes, Cosmetics & Other Toilet Preparations). The 'Household Products' box does not show that 44% of sales is oral care and 23% is Hill's pet food.

hq.note: EDGAR business address and Wikipedia S&P 500 list both New York, NY

employees.note: About 33,600 in over 100 countries; over 84% outside the US; about two-thirds of revenue from outside the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: North America (Oral, Personal and Home Care)
businessLines.how: Retailers (Walmart is about 11% of company sales) and wholesalers buy toothpaste, soap and cleaners on repeat orders; revenue depends on price increases and volume in mature categories, and on promotion spend.
businessLines.description: Colgate, Tom's of Maine, Palmolive, Softsoap, Irish Spring, Lady Speed Stick and other oral, personal and home care products sold in the US and Canada.

operatingProfit.note: Segment total $5,022M (sum computed) before corporate items; FY2024 $839M. Net sales -1.6%.

businessLines.marketShare: The 10-K gives share by category, not by region: global toothpaste share was down in North America in 2025.

businessLines.name: Latin America
businessLines.how: Same product model sold through local retailers and wholesalers; dollar results also swing with local currencies.
businessLines.description: Oral, personal and home care across Latin America.

businessLines.name: Europe
businessLines.how: Retailers buy toothpaste and personal care on repeat orders; premium oral care brands (elmex, meridol) carry price.
businessLines.description: Oral, personal and home care in Europe (elmex, meridol, Sanex, Sorriso and others). From Q2 2026 Europe and Africa/Eurasia are reported together as EMEA.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $658M (+14%). Net sales +6.9%. Toothpaste share up in Europe in 2025.

businessLines.name: Asia Pacific
businessLines.how: Retail and e-commerce sales of oral care and personal care products; China demand weakness is the swing factor named in the 10-K.
businessLines.description: Oral, personal and home care in Asia Pacific (Colgate, Darlie, hello and others).

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $812M (-6%). Net sales -1.5%. Toothpaste share flat in Asia Pacific in 2025.

businessLines.name: Africa/Eurasia
businessLines.how: Retail and wholesale sales of the same products, in Africa and Eurasia.
businessLines.description: Oral, personal and home care in Africa and Eurasia.

businessLines.name: Hill's Pet Nutrition
businessLines.how: Pet owners buy bags and cans repeatedly through authorised pet-supply retailers, veterinarians and e-commerce retailers; Prescription Diet is a range of therapeutic pet foods.
businessLines.description: Hill's Science Diet (Science Plan in Europe), Prescription Diet (therapeutic) and other specialty dog and cat food sold in over 80 countries; acquired the Prime100 pet-food business (Australia) on 2025-04-30 for AU$471M ($301M).

brands.name: Colgate (toothpaste, toothbrush, mouthwash), Darlie, elmex, hello, meridol, Sorriso, Tom's of Maine
brands.share: 44% of FY2025 net sales; Colgate share of global toothpaste market 41.3% (-0.4 pts) and of global manual toothbrush market 32.4% (+0.4 pts), FY2025, per the 10-K (Nielsen data plus internal estimates)

brands.name: Palmolive, Softsoap, Irish Spring, Protex, Sanex, Lady Speed Stick, EltaMD, Filorga, PCA SKIN
brands.share: 17% of FY2025 net sales; skin health (Filorga) impaired by $919M pre-tax in Q4 2025
